name: Agatha Heizler
bioAdditions: The tree's death date is now confirmed from the register. The Munzingen death book for 1867 (No. 13) records that on 3 Aug 1867, at three in the morning, 'Agatha Birkenmaier geb. Heitzler' died at Munzingen, having received the last sacraments. She was buried on 5 August. She was 54 years, 1 month and 8 days old, which counts back exactly to her birth on 26 Jun 1813. The entry calls her the widow of the late citizen and joiner Servaz Birkenmaier, so she had not remarried in the 14 years since 1853. The witnesses were Johann Georg Birkenmaier, gravedigger, and a farmer [Franz Lang?], both citizens. The priest signed on 5 Aug 1867 (S1). Her name is indexed as 'Birkenmaier Agatha, p. 446' in the 1867 death register index (S1).

openQuestionsResolved.question: Did she remarry after 1853?
openQuestionsResolved.answer: No. In 1867 she died as the widow of Servaz Birkenmaier.
